integrity_and_rerun_rules.mechanical_rerun_if_ever_authorized: must be justified solely by documented external/mechanical failure, never by observed effects
integrity_and_rerun_rules.negative_cgroup_delta: invalidate arm run; never clamp to zero; freeze attempt for audit
integrity_and_rerun_rules.partial_execution: freeze exact partial attempt; assistant audit required before any rerun authorization

confidence_interval.kind: stratified percentile bootstrap for mean paired difference
confidence_interval.resampling: resample 15 paired sessions with replacement within each of 20 frozen strata

primary_endpoint_family.confirmatory_metric_claim_rule: A metric-specific reduction is confirmatory only if measurement integrity passes, observed mean paired difference is < 0, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05.
primary_endpoint_family.estimand: equal-weight mean paired difference over the frozen confirmatory cohort; all 20 strata have equal session counts
primary_endpoint_family.global_claim_rule: Do not infer a global system-benefit claim merely because one or more endpoints pass. Report endpoint-specific confirmation and the full multiplicity-adjusted family.
primary_endpoint_family.multiplicity: Holm step-down across all 8 frozen primary metrics

permutation_test.kind: paired sign-flip randomization test of the mean paired difference

secondary_break_even_family.purpose: Preserve the practical deployment break-even diagnostic without changing NH-R4, which remains the dedicated scale/concurrency/break-even stage.
secondary_break_even_family.status: secondary; not part of the primary multiplicity family
